measures.title: Real-World Benchmarks
measures.body: Tasks derived from actual git history and production codebases — not synthetic toy problems. We measure agent performance on the work your team actually does.

measures.title: Multi-Dimensional Scoring
measures.body: Not just 'does it compile' — we score architecture compliance, code quality, test coverage, domain modeling, and adherence to team conventions.

measures.title: Baseline & Progress
measures.body: Establish where your team's AI setup performs today and track improvement over time as harness and skills evolve. Data-driven optimization, not guesswork.

measures.title: Feedback Loop
measures.body: Evaluation results feed directly into harness and skill improvements. Every benchmark run reveals what to optimize next — creating a continuous improvement cycle.

pillars.title: Development Process Design
pillars.tag: The Right Process Makes Tools Work

items.d: Our modelers work with your business experts to identify and structure domain knowledge that AI agents need to produce quality code
We design how developers, architects, and AI agents collaborate — clear roles, handoff points, and feedback loops
Process changes only work when teams adopt them. We coach your developers through the transition to AI-augmented workflows
Regular retrospectives and measurement to evolve your process as AI capabilities and team maturity grow
We analyze your current setup and identify configuration gaps that limit agent effectiveness
The right tools connected the right way — code search, LSP, documentation, custom integrations
Agents need the right information at the right time — we design what context flows where
Structuring codebase knowledge for more effective agent reasoning

pillars.title: Skills Development
pillars.tag: Skills Are Software — Build, Test, Iterate

items.d: Codified domain knowledge, project conventions, and architectural patterns unique to your codebase
Proven patterns for testing, refactoring, and code quality that work across projects
Activation testing confirms a skill loads. Outcome testing proves it works. We do both.
Skills versioned, shared, and maintained like any other engineering artifact

pillars.title: From Meeting to Working Software
pillars.tag: Shorter Path from Decisions to Code

items.d: We're shortening the path from team discussions to design documents with sound architectural decisions
AI agents execute from precise specifications with deterministic verification at every step
When verification fails, agents receive structured feedback and iterate autonomously
Architecture compliance, test suites, and code standards checked on every change

problems.title: Wrong Focus
problems.body: Teams obsess over which LLM to use, but the agent is not the variable. Without a deliberate development process — and domain experts who can extract and structure business knowledge for AI — even the best tools underperform.

problems.title: Skills Gap
problems.body: AI prompts and workflows are treated as throwaway artifacts. No versioning, no testing, no iteration. Teams reinvent the wheel with every project.

problems.title: No Measurement
problems.body: Teams have no way to know if their AI setup actually works. No baselines, no benchmarks, no feedback loop for improvement. Just vibes.
